finalText:
**Build is clean.** Exit 0, 8 warnings (all noisy `DEP0xxx` deprecation notices), 0 errors.

Two real bugs, both from the bundler bump:

- [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) threw on `undefined` flags. New config loader leaves unset flags `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled.

Next: nothing. Build passes and links cleanly.
